## Books Class

A reporting dimension, like a class in small-business accounting software: a line of business or channel that documents tag their lines with. Fields: `name`, and `parent` (the name of the class it rolls up to, as a string). `cardTitle` is the name.

Documents carry the class as a plain string (`cls`) on their posting lines, matched to this card's `name`; Profit by Class groups income, cost of goods sold and expenses by that tag. The card itself computes nothing and has no operations.

```ts
import { BooksClass } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/accounting/ledger-dimensions';
```

### Non-goals
No enforced hierarchy (the parent is a label, not a link) and no validation that a document's class exists.
